decisions.reason: A wood-floor cleaning soap draws directly on the firm's surface-treatment and wood knowledge, so it can interpret customer feedback and refine the product at low cost as part of the accessory range.
A maintenance oil complements the firm's oiled floors and relies on its in-house finishing expertise, which gives it strong capacity to assimilate results and improve the product.
This care product for oiled floors fits the firm's existing care system and technical guidance, though it overlaps somewhat with the oil and soap, which slightly raises the chance of consolidation.
A moisture-protection underlay builds on the firm's installation know-how and supports floor sales, so it is worth keeping even though the material science is partly sourced from partners.
A high-density foam underlay is a useful system accessory, but it sits a little further from the firm's core wood knowledge and may be rationalised alongside the other underlay.
An oak parquet floor is the firm's core competence, where its wood-processing and R&D know-how allow it to fully exploit and improve the product.
